capabilities: link verse references to YouVersion via a configurable trigger character
quote verses or insert them as footnotes
detect multiple verse ranges such as John 3:16,18-20
configure the Bible version and trigger characters in settings
detect book names in supported languages, including Polish
extras: Supported languages are listed in a separate linked document; extending to new languages requires following docs/Languages.md.
intentEvidence: heavily inspired by obsidian-bible-reference (also i have "borrowed" some code from there)
motivation: The author is from Poland and built the plugin to support Polish book names like 'J 1:1-6' and 'Mt 24,1', inviting others to add their own languages via a guide.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to detect Bible verse references in notes and turn them into links or quotations from an online Bible.

relations.evidence: The plugins is heavily inspired by obsidian-bible-reference (also i have "borrowed" some code from there)

summary: Verse-linker that detects Bible references typed after trigger characters and links, quotes, or footnotes them using YouVersion.
